lessons.desc: Stable operation over six observations
Vibration and acoustic energy rise: bearing wear
Temperature and current trend upward: overheating
Pressure rises while flow collapses: leak/blockage
Vibration, RPM and torque diverge: rotor imbalance
Oil quality degrades before heat rises
Current and voltage become unstable: electrical fault
Multiple critical trends require emergency stop
